description: T-5358: one delete_row of rows 2-7 (count 6), more rows than a table without a header row holds, from the row above it to the row below it: does Excel delete the table, or refuse (the answer wanted is then the refusal and its error code)? Sales on S!B3:C6 without a header row (columns Column1/Column2, data rows 3-6: E,W,N,S and Qty 1,2,4,8; table-no-header-delete-first-row's layout), S!B2 'above' and S!C10 99 outside it. Sheet F holds A1 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(Sales[Column2]), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =S!C10, A6 FORMULATEXT(A5) (how far the cells below move), A7 =SUM(S!C3:C6), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7), A9 =ISREF(Sales) (is there still a table), A10 =INDEX(S!B:B,3) (what sheet row 3 holds after the edit, through a whole-column reference a row delete does not move).
